description:
Monster games for monster trainers
If you like monster games, building a monster team in open world, role playing games with multiplayer in the arena, you will love this monster RPG: More than 170 monsters in an epic RPG for monster trainers!🗺🏞⚔️

Dive into a fascinating open world with more than 30 hours offline gameplay 🌅🌄
A paid monster game for RPG monster catching fans and trainers all around the world 🌍
Dive into an open world loved by millions of players!

Start your adventure full of pocket monsters. Duel in the arena to get the monster champion in multiplayer.💎🛡⚔️

Experience great questsand collect rewards as idle monster trainer! 

Start monster catching as a monster trainer
• More than 170 mighty monsters to catch! 🐲
• Over 99 monster evolutions
• Fully animated battles and pocket monster evolution ⚔️
• Challenge and battle other trainers in role-playing multiplayer!
• Enjoy retro pixel graphics like in classic oldschool rpg monster games
• Adjust attacks, skills and stats of your monsters! ⚔️
• Evolve your idle monster and reach the final nexo evo-lution 
• Nostalgia for fans of games like classic  monster games in oldschool pixel graphics

Items, monsters, multiplayer, trainer & open world!
• More than 30 hours of playtime waits for you in this classic MMORPG pixel art monster game 🗺
• Play it offline and without an internet connection, if you like 🎮
• Use different items in battle and multiplayer with mighty monsters 💎🛡
• Dive into a fascinating open world  and enjoy role-playing elements as monster rancher
• PVP multiplayer for arena fights, battles and duels in pixel graphics

Can you be a monster master trainer? If you like RPG monster games, multiplyer battles and training pixel art monsters in RPG maker style, you will love this game! 
Join more than 5 million players in this paid game!🎮⚔️
